# Teorema de Bayes


La P(B) se denominar la probabilidad total

$$
P(A_i/B) = \frac{P(A_i \cap B)}{P(B)} = \frac{P(A_i \cap B)}{\sum_{j=1}^{K}P(A_j \cap B)}, P(B) > 0  
$$




$$
P(A_3/B) = \frac{P(A_3 \cap B)}{P(B)} = \frac{P(A_3 \cap B)}{\sum_{j=1}^{3}P(A_j \cap B)}  = \frac{P(A_3 \cap B)}{P(A_1 \cap B)+P(A_2 \cap B)+P(A_3 \cap B)} = 
$$

Con $P(B) > 0$


$$
=\frac{P(A_3)P(B/A_3)}{P(A_1)P(B/A_1)+P(A_2)P(B/A_2)+P(A_3)P(B/A_3)}
$$

```{r}
a <- (4/7) * (3/6)
b <- (3/7) * (2/6)
a / (a+b)
```
